title: Nice Casual table cloth, should be ironed.received napkins also, not as nice. Update.
text:
Nice Casual table cloth, should be ironed.received napkins also, not as nice. Update.. Up-date. Disappointed ..Also received yellow & white napkin.
The napkin are not as nice as the table cloth. The napkins HAVE to be Ironed. I'll probably just use them as bar mops.
------------------
casual 100% cotton table cloth. Made in India.
Gray and White Check.
Has a inch machine sticked all around.
I washed this table cloth, and took it out of the dryer while it was still hot. I smoothed it out,
and folded it smooth again.
Before folding using, it should be ironed, or steamed , it would look better.

When I used it for a casual family dinner with white dinner plates, it looked nice on the table,
and the table cloth seems to be well made.
I ordered the yellow checked napkins, which I have not received yet, but the contrast will look nice
for outdoor use in the summer.
